name: CPLEX Optimization Studio 20.1
product: IBM ILOG CPLEX Optimization Studio 20.1.0 macOS installer (IBM)

evidence.says: IBM lists the 20.1.0 macOS .app as the product installer.
IBM records December 11, 2020 as general availability for the CPLEX Optimization Studio 20.1 release.

limitation: The scan captures the installer, so it does not establish the architecture of the installed IDE or optimization engines.

name: Meshmixer
product: Autodesk Meshmixer for Mac

evidence.says: Autodesk confirms that Meshmixer is out of active development and is no longer supported.
An Autodesk employee confirms that the macOS 3.5 installer was removed due to a security issue.
An Autodesk employee identifies the legacy Mac app as Intel-based and warns that recent macOS versions may still prevent it from launching.
The submitted Mac bundle identifies itself as version 11.5.474 and its executable has only an x86 slice.

limitation: Autodesk warns that the legacy app may fail to launch on newer macOS even with Rosetta.
notes: The final Mac line was Intel-only. Autodesk recommends Fusion for mesh work.

name: Dragon
product: Nuance Dragon Professional Individual for Mac 6
limitation: The final Mac executable was unavailable for inspection.

evidence.says: Nuance ended sales and updates for Dragon Professional Individual for Mac on October 22, 2018, and identifies version 6 as the version retained by perpetual-license owners.
Nuance dates the 6.0.8 Mac update to October 19, 2017.
The Nuance reseller points existing Mac customers to 6.0.8 as the latest service pack at discontinuation.

name: Remove Soundtoys
product: Soundtoys plug-in uninstaller
notes: The listing is for the uninstaller in the Soundtoys Utilities folder.

evidence.says: Soundtoys calls Remove Soundtoys its macOS plug-in uninstaller and documents its location and use.

name: MKVtools
product: MKVtools 3 (EmmGunn Software)

evidence.says: The vendor identifies its current 3.7.2 release, dated October 13, 2019, as 64-bit Intel-only.
Homebrew identifies 3.7.2 as Intel-only and lists Rosetta 2 as a requirement on Apple Silicon.

limitation: Homebrew's Rosetta prerequisite does not establish that this release runs successfully under translation.

name: The Powder Toy
product: The Powder Toy by The Powder Toy project

evidence.says: The project lists 100.1 as the current release with a separate macOS Arm download.
The upstream August 8, 2026 release tag for v100.1.400 confirms a macOS arm64 build and flags a signing issue for the GitHub artifact.

notes: The upstream release notes warn that the GitHub arm64 artifact is improperly signed and point users to the official download page for packaged releases.

name: Annotation Edit
product: Annotation Edit by zeitAnker

evidence.says: zeitAnker explicitly offers Annotation Edit 2.1.6 for Apple Silicon Macs as an app-only download.

notes: The separately offered 2.0.123 suite package includes other universal tools and has its own version number.

name: Streamlabs Desktop
product: Streamlabs Desktop, formerly Streamlabs OBS (Streamlabs)

evidence.says: The current official download page offers separate Intel and Apple Silicon editions of Streamlabs Desktop for Mac.
The live Apple Silicon download selected from the vendor's page resolves on a Mac user agent to the vendor's versioned 1.21.6 arm64 disk image.

notes: 1.21.6 is the public Mac installer served by the download page.

name: PGPTSession
product: PGPT Session Version 2 (Pete Gates, Free Range Audio)

evidence.says: The developer still offers PGPT Session 2.18.10 for Mac and explicitly identifies it as a 64-bit Universal Binary.

notes: PT Session 3 has its own download and is separate from the legacy Version 2 build verified here.

name: Red Giant Link
product: Red Giant Link product updater (Red Giant)

evidence.says: Red Giant's volume subscription guide identifies Red Giant Application Manager as the replacement for Red Giant Link.
Reporting on Universe 3.1 confirms that the Red Giant Application Manager replaced Link for installing and managing Universe.

limitation: The final Link version and its architecture were not established.
notes: Link was the updater for other Red Giant products.

name: DeltaWalker
product: Deltopia DeltaWalker Classic (formerly DeltaWalker)
limitation: Deltopia gives October 2026 as the release month without specifying a day.
notes: The Classic line keeps the scanned bundle ID. The separate DeltaWalker Desktop beta is a different app, and DeltaWalker 2.8.1 remains available in ARM64 and Intel builds.

evidence.says: Deltopia offers distinct ARM64 and Intel disk images for DeltaWalker Classic 3.0.9.
Deltopia lists Classic 3.0.9 in October 2026 and documents that the earlier Classic bundle rename retained com.deltopia.DeltaWalker.

name: DrCleaner
product: Trend Micro Dr. Cleaner for Mac
limitation: The final Dr. Cleaner release number and its architecture were not established.
notes: Trend Micro points users to its separate Cleaner One Pro app.

evidence.says: Trend Micro says the original Dr. Cleaner will stop receiving updates and identifies Cleaner One Pro as its replacement.
Trend Micro identifies Dr. Cleaner among its original Mac App Store apps.

name: Work
product: Apple Automator workflow applet saved as Work
notes: The scanned bundle wraps a workflow under a user-assigned name.

evidence.says: The submitted Work.app identifies itself as an Automator applet and names its main executable Application Stub.

name: Room EQ Wizard
product: REW (Room EQ Wizard) by John Mulcahy

evidence.says: The project lists 5.31.3 as its current stable release and describes the corresponding Mac download as a notarized universal binary for Intel and ARM Macs.

name: DriveDx
product: BinaryFruit DriveDx

evidence.says: BinaryFruit dates DriveDx 1.12.1 build 760 to September 25, 2023 and documents the addition of native Apple Silicon support in 1.12.0.
Inspection of DriveDx.app/Contents/MacOS/DriveDx in the official 1.12.1 ZIP found both x86_64 and arm64 slices and confirmed bundle ID com.binaryfruit.DriveDx.

name: Polypane
product: Polypane developer browser (Firstversionist)

evidence.says: The vendor announced Polypane 32 on November 18, 2026, and offers a Mac ARM build.
The vendor's versioned release assets identify Polypane-32.0.0-arm64.dmg as the Mac ARM64 package.

notes: An older positive scan for 7.0.0 is present in the batch alongside a negative scan for 7.0.1.

name: Offline Pages Pro
product: Codium Labs Offline Pages Pro for Mac
limitation: Architecture comes from the submitted copy of the same App Store version, and no Apple Silicon runtime test was located.
notes: The iPad edition has a separate App Store identifier.

evidence.says: The dedicated Mac App Store product currently lists version 1.4, released May 5, 2017.
The recorded Mach-O scan for bundle com.codiumlabs.offlinepages.osx version 1.4 lists x86 only and its plist points to the same Mac App Store product.

name: insTuner
product: EUMLab insTuner for Mac, sold by Polybeat PTE. LTD.
limitation: Architecture comes from a submitted copy of the same Mac version, and no Apple Silicon runtime report identified the Mac build.
notes: The iPhone and iPad tuner products are separate listings.

evidence.says: The dedicated Mac App Store product still lists version 1.3, dated November 23, 2015, with EUMLab copyright.
The recorded scan for com.eumlab.insTuner4Mac version 1.3 identifies x86 as its only executable architecture.

name: WakaMenu
product: Hiroshi Horie WakaMenu, an unofficial WakaTime menu bar client
limitation: Rosetta execution could not be verified.

evidence.says: The maintainer's GitHub release API dates tag 1.0 to May 14, 2020 and lists the WakaMenu.app.zip release asset.
Inspection of WakaMenu.app/Contents/MacOS/WakaMenu confirmed a solely x86_64 executable, bundle ID WakaMenu, and app version 1.0.0.

name: HitFilm Express
product: FXhome HitFilm Express for Mac
limitation: The final build date and architecture come from MacUpdater.

evidence.says: FXhome says it has been sunset and no longer accepts new registrations.
FXhome confirms that support for all its software has ended.
MacUpdater identifies the exact HitFilm Express bundle’s 2021.3 build 18.0.1530 as Intel-only and dates it to April 7, 2022.

name: SoundQ
product: SoundQ (Pro Sound Effects)

evidence.says: Pro Sound Effects lists 2026.11.20 at the top of its SoundQ release notes and serves that release through the Mac download.
Static inspection of SoundQ.app/Contents/MacOS/SoundQ inside the official 2026.11.20 package found a universal Mach-O with x86_64 and arm64 slices.

name: PSE Download Manager
product: PSE Download Manager (Pro Sound Effects)

evidence.says: Pro Sound Effects provides a separate macOS Download Manager and lists a minimum macOS version without specifying CPU architecture.
The current Mac download resolves to the vendor's live versioned 2026.9.29 package.

limitation: The 161 MB package exceeds the audit's binary-inspection limit and the vendor does not specify architecture.
notes: This utility bulk-downloads purchased sound libraries and has its own release separate from SoundQ.

name: Vadi Sound Library
product: Vadi Sound Library desktop app (Vadi Sound)

evidence.says: Vadi Sound's own terms identify a distinct computer application named Vadi Sound Library.
The live storefront offers sound libraries for purchase and provides no current Mac installer or architecture information.

limitation: The current Mac release, its architecture, and any formal end-of-life notice were not found.

name: Xray Exploratory App
product: Xray Exploratory App Desktop Application by Xray (originally Xpand IT, now Idera)

evidence.says: Xray documents separate macOS x64 and arm64 disk images starting with 2.0.5.
Xray's April 7 release notes identify 3.1.7 as a Windows and Mac desktop release.

notes: The app can run standalone or integrate with Xray for Jira.

name: Nuendo
product: Nuendo by Steinberg

evidence.says: Steinberg explicitly lists Nuendo 15.0.40 as compatible in native Apple Silicon mode on macOS 27.
Steinberg announced the availability of the 15.0.40 maintenance update on October 28, 2026.
Steinberg identifies Nuendo 12 as the first Nuendo release with native Apple Silicon support.

notes: The listing's Nuendo 11 scans predate native support. Steinberg's release-notes page gives October 14, 2026 for 15.0.40, whereas its availability announcement and contemporaneous Download Assistant reports are dated October 28.

name: Seasonality Core
product: Seasonality Core by Gaucho Software

evidence.says: Gaucho Software says Seasonality Core has been discontinued and links to the free final release.
Inspection of Seasonality Core.app/Contents/MacOS/Seasonality Core and its Info.plist confirms that the official 2.9 build 670 ships x86_64 and arm64 slices.

notes: The final release is universal and its app bundle specifies macOS 13.5 as the minimum.

name: iRamDisk
product: iRamDisk by Magnesium-App (Parrotsoft bundle identifier)

evidence.says: The 2025 report explicitly says iRamDisk sales and support ended.
The historical scan ties Magnesium-App and bundle ID com.parrotsoft.iRamDisk to an x86 build of version 3.5.1.
MajorGeeks lists Magnesium-App’s iRamDisk 3.6.15 as requiring a 64-bit Intel Mac.

limitation: The final version and its architecture could not be verified.

name: Molotov
product: Molotov desktop TV app by Molotov

evidence.says: Molotov offers a dedicated Apple Silicon desktop download alongside a separate Intel download.
The Molotov cask identifies version 7.0.0 and records the vendor's mac/m1 ZIP URL.
The inspected Molotov 7.0.0 Apple Silicon ZIP contains an arm64 Mach-O at Molotov.app/Contents/MacOS/Molotov.

name: PDF Toolkit
product: PDF Toolkit, now PDF Toolkit +, by Mobile Science Apps (François-Xavier Coudert)

evidence.says: The scanned PDF Toolkit 1.8 bundle shows the original com.fxcoudert.pdftools ID and Mobile Science Apps copyright.
The same publisher’s PDF Toolkit + listing includes 1.8 in its version history and says that 2.6 is native on Apple Silicon and supports older Intel systems.
Apple’s store metadata dates 2.6 to May 19, 2026 and lists the current bundle ID as net.delsuc.pdftoolkit.

notes: The publisher and 1.8 version history link the original listing to the renamed App Store release despite the changed bundle ID.

name: FreeMind
product: FreeMind mind-mapping app (FreeMind project)

evidence.says: The project's Mac page dates the 1.0.1 disk image to April 12, 2014.
The project still lists FreeMind 1.0.1 as its current stable Mac release.
The historical scan of version 1.0.1 build 0 records an Intel-only JavaAppLauncher and a bundled Java 7 runtime.
An M1 MacBook Air user reports that FreeMind opened on Monterey and confirmed that changing the zoom made the map readable.

limitation: The firsthand compatibility report covers Monterey and includes font-rendering problems, and reliable operation on newer macOS versions was not established.
notes: Freeplane and the independently modernized FreeMind forks are separate products.

name: Data Virtuality Studio
product: CData Virtuality Studio (formerly Data Virtuality Studio)

evidence.says: CData documents a Mac package for Virtuality Studio that customers obtain through their Virtuality web interface.
The vendor lists Studio hardware requirements without identifying the macOS package's CPU architecture.

limitation: A public versioned macOS installer or a vendor statement tying a Studio build to a CPU architecture was not available.
notes: The Studio client is distributed through a Virtuality instance.

name: The Tagger
product: Deadbeat Software The Tagger
limitation: There is no vendor end-of-life notice or exact release day, and Rosetta execution was not verified.

evidence.says: The vendor's domain now serves a Namecheap domain parking page with no product distribution.
AlternativeTo records The Tagger as no longer updated and identifies 1.6.2 from June 2017 as its last version.
The recorded scan for the exact 1.6.2 application bundle lists only x86 and shows a 64-bit Mach-O header.

name: Mac Auto Clicker
product: Mac Auto Clicker 1.1, distributed as FastClicker (MacAutoClicker.com / Advanced Mouse Auto Clicker Ltd.)

evidence.says: The historical scan identifies bundle com.macautoclicker.Mac-Auto-Clicker as Mac Auto Clicker 1.1 from MacAutoClicker.com and reports an Intel slice.
The current mirror entry identifies Advanced Mouse Auto Clicker Ltd. and lists version 1.1 under the download filename FastClicker.zip.
The domain named in the scanned bundle now directs visitors to Mahdi Bchatnia's different clicker.

limitation: Current official distribution and support status for the original bundle could not be verified.
notes: MurGaa's similarly named Fast Clicker has a different bundle ID, and the software promoted at the original domain now comes from a different developer.

name: Launchpad Manager
product: Launchpad Manager by Attila Miklosi

evidence.says: The developer says the original Launchpad Manager is no longer updated and is limited to macOS Sequoia and earlier.
Inspection of Launchpad Manager.app/Contents/MacOS/Launchpad Manager and its Info.plist confirms that 1.0.14 is universal with x86_64 and arm64 slices.

notes: The final release is universal. The developer offers AppGrid as a separate app for macOS Tahoe.

name: MindManager
product: Corel (formerly Mindjet) MindManager for Mac
limitation: The developer's Rosetta 2 article does not name a version, current release notes omit architecture, and the 295 MB official installer is over the audit's binary-inspection limit.
notes: The scanned MindManager 13 bundle belongs to the same versioned product line.

evidence.says: The current product library offers MindManager Mac 26 as the newest Mac desktop release.
The October 14, 2026 release notes identify build 26.0.111 and mention macOS compatibility without specifying CPU architecture.
The vendor describes Rosetta 2 support generically without identifying a Mac release or build.
A third-party page labeling 26.0.111 as universal attributes its listing to Homebrew metadata and does not show executable inspection.

name: Brackets
product: Brackets web code editor for Mac, originally Adobe and continued by brackets-cont
limitation: The inspected Intel shell belongs to the 2.2.0 Mac delivery, and no confirmed Rosetta run of that release was found.
notes: The Mac executable retains the old 1.14.2 bundle version while the packaged editor reports API version 2.2.0. Phoenix Code is a separate successor.

evidence.says: The community maintainer's release API dates version 2.2.0 to March 14, 2023 and lists its Mac disk image.
Inspection found an x86_64-only Mach-O at Brackets.app/Contents/MacOS/Brackets and confirmed bundle ID io.brackets.appshell and the packaged editor's 2.2.0 API version.
The later 2.2.1 patch is explicitly Windows-only.
The continuation project states that the Brackets repository accepts security patches and active development has moved to Phoenix Code.

name: Banktivity
product: Banktivity for Mac by IGG Software

evidence.says: Inspection of Banktivity.app/Contents/MacOS/Banktivity and its Info.plist confirms that the vendor's 10.2.2 build 440 is universal with x86_64 and arm64 slices.
The Mac App Store lists Banktivity 10.2.2 with a November 4 release date.
IGG provides upgrade instructions from Banktivity 7 to version 10 and says the older files must be located manually.

notes: The scan is of the older Banktivity 7 edition. The current app uses com.iggsoftware.banktivity, and its direct download requires macOS 12.4 or newer.

name: Swackett
product: Swackett desktop weather app by AGLogic

evidence.says: The Swackett product profile includes the Mac app and reports that it was discontinued and that the website and apps are unavailable.
The AGLogic Mac edition was distributed as an Intel-only app at least through version 5.0.10.
Apple's US storefront lookup returns no result for the exact Swackett Mac bundle ID.

limitation: No vendor end-of-life notice or final build architecture was found.

name: DyingLightGame
product: Dying Light (2015) for Mac by Techland

evidence.says: Techland's current Steam listing offers macOS and specifies only Intel CPUs and AMD Radeon graphics in the Mac system requirements.
The current indexed macOS depot contains DyingLightGame.app and its libBink2Macx64 framework.
A November 2026 Steam purchaser reports playing Dying Light through Rosetta on their M2 MacBook.
Andrew Tsai demonstrates the Steam Mac edition running with Rosetta 2 and Metal on an M1 MacBook Air.

limitation: The game's current Mac version number and coverage across macOS releases remain unverified.
notes: The DyingLightGame.app bundle is the first Dying Light game. Does It ARM already has a separate game listing for Dying Light with a Rosetta 2 report.

name: QIDI-Print
product: QIDI Print Slicer, the Cura-based slicer by QIDI Tech

evidence.says: The vendor lists QIDI Print Slicer 6.5.4, dated February 2023, for its older printer models.
The Mac folder in QIDI's official 6.5.4 download lists the versioned DMG as 286 MB without an architecture label.
The vendor repository identifies QIDI Print as the Cura-based slicer.

limitation: The 6.5.4 Mac binary architecture is undocumented in the sources checked and the 286 MB disk image exceeds the inspection limit.
notes: QIDISlicer and QIDI Studio are separate slicers.
